metadata.title: Phase 1A.3a Business Capability Model
metadata.evidenceBoundary: Closed Phase 1A.2 source model and accepted Phase 1A documentation/index artifacts only.

capabilities.businessDefinition: Create, inspect, update, transfer, and export member records or member-specific information.
Manage the union, local, organization, committee, and bargaining-unit structure represented in the action graph.
Initiate user invitations and manage account, sign-in, profile, or access-administration steps evidenced in the closed action graph.

capabilities.capabilityName: Create and maintain grievance and claim matters
capabilities.businessDefinition: Create, review, update, or triage grievance, claim, incident, or related institutional matter records.
Select, assign, transfer, or coordinate responsibility for member or case work where the source action identifies that job.
Calculate or act on statutory, claim, grievance, or matter deadlines represented in the closed graph; no reminder-engine behavior is inferred.

capabilities.capabilityName: Record and manage communications about a matter
capabilities.businessDefinition: Compose, review, or associate correspondence and communications with a grievance, claim, or other institutional matter.
Upload, share, compare, or retrieve documents and other evidence in support of a case, claim, grievance, or collective agreement.
Explore collective agreements, compare clauses or benchmarks, and manage bargaining proposals or review tasks represented in the graph.
capabilities.newDomainJustification: Collective bargaining is directly named by closed action-graph surfaces, but the supplied finalized taxonomy has no bargaining domain; OTHER_EXPLICIT is used rather than misclassifying this as grievance casework.

capabilities.businessDefinition: Create, update, select, or synchronize calendar events and meetings represented by source-bound actions.
Manage governance records, committee work, reserved matters, votes, and institutional oversight actions.
Set up election candidates or processes and support the ballot-selection or submission steps present in the source graph.

capabilities.capabilityName: Manage workplace health and safety matters
capabilities.businessDefinition: Record, inspect, report, or follow up on workplace safety incidents, hazards, corrective actions, and inspection findings.
Create, review, target, or coordinate organizing campaigns and related member-engagement work represented in the graph.

capabilities.capabilityName: Review dues, deductions, and payment records
capabilities.businessDefinition: Review member dues, payroll deductions, receipts, or payment details and report a deduction issue; payment completion is not inferred.
Review, calculate, reconcile, or report on institutional dues, remittances, billing cycles, and payment records.
Prepare or review budgets, expense requests, vendor records, financial forecasts, and related institutional reporting.
Manage communications, message threads, notification preferences, templates, or announcements not specifically tied to one case.

capabilities.capabilityName: Maintain arbitration precedents and jurisdiction preferences
capabilities.businessDefinition: Review, maintain, or configure arbitration-precedent records and jurisdiction preferences explicitly represented in the closed action graph.
capabilities.newDomainJustification: The closed action graph explicitly identifies arbitration precedents and jurisdiction preferences, which are not a named finalized domain; OTHER_EXPLICIT avoids conflating them with grievance case records.

capabilities.businessDefinition: Upload, organize, retrieve, or export institutional documents where the closed action graph supports a document-handling job outside case evidence.
Access or administer courses, member learning, and training certificates identified in source-bound actions.
Capture, organize, or transfer institutional context, memory-holder information, and responsibility during personnel or representative transitions.
Generate, refresh, inspect, or export dashboards, analytics, reports, and institutional data extracts.
Review pilot applications, onboarding, readiness, feedback, and proposal-package actions in the source graph.

capabilities.capabilityName: Receive public inquiries and pilot requests
capabilities.businessDefinition: Collect public contact or pilot-request information through source-bound form and submission actions.
capabilities.newDomainJustification: The taxonomy has no public-relations domain; the graph contains explicit public inquiry/request workflows, retained as OTHER_EXPLICIT.

capabilities.businessDefinition: Capture assessment responses and associated consent steps represented by ICRA assessment actions.
capabilities.newDomainJustification: The closed graph explicitly represents ICRA assessment actions, while the finalized taxonomy has no distinct workplace risk-assessment domain.

capabilities.businessDefinition: Submit peer nominations or redemption requests in the recognition actions present in the closed graph.
capabilities.newDomainJustification: The source graph contains explicit peer nomination and redemption actions, while the finalized taxonomy has no recognition domain.

capabilities.businessDefinition: Use trustee or pension-specific action paths represented in the closed graph; no wider pension administration capability is inferred.
capabilities.newDomainJustification: The action graph identifies trustee/pension-specific work not named by the supplied finalized domain taxonomy.

capabilities.capabilityName: Review organizational compliance and risk controls
capabilities.businessDefinition: Perform explicit institutional compliance, consent, or risk-control actions evidenced in source-bound handlers.
Review and coordinate dispatch or workbench actions that are explicitly represented as work coordination, without asserting a case outcome.
capabilities.newDomainJustification: Dispatch/workbench coordination appears in the closed action graph but is not a named finalized domain; OTHER_EXPLICIT avoids an invented taxonomy domain.

capabilities.businessDefinition: Perform administrative setup, configuration, data maintenance, system controls, and operational settings evidenced by named actions.
Provide AI/copilot-oriented case triage, employer-risk, or steward-support steps represented in the action graph; this is separate from matter ownership or resolution.
Provide AI or generated clause and agreement-analysis steps represented in the graph, separately from collective-bargaining records and decisions.
capabilities.newDomainJustification: Collective-agreement assistance follows the explicit bargaining domain exception described for COLLECTIVE_BARGAINING.

legacyCapability.title: Member dues portal — payroll deduction history

legacyRegistryReconciliation.rationale: Deduction-history actions belong to the same member-facing dues self-service ability.

legacyCapability.title: Member dues portal — direct Stripe payment / autopay / saved payment methods

legacyRegistryReconciliation.rationale: The closed graph contains dues payment-selection actions, but does not prove payment completion; retain the action under member dues self-service with its ceiling obligation.

legacyCapability.title: Deadline engine — recipient continuity across representative reassignment

legacyRegistryReconciliation.rationale: The registry row makes a backend recipient-continuity claim that is not established by this closed action graph; case responsibility and deadlines remain separate modeled source actions.

legacyCapability.title: Claim deadlines (claim_deadlines table) — latent, unexposed surface

legacyRegistryReconciliation.rationale: The source graph includes jurisdictional deadline calculation actions; it does not establish the latent claim_deadlines table surface or persistence.

A reminder scheduler is a backend process; no runtime reminder capability is asserted.
Scheduled-report UI labels are not a separate capability; any source-supported report actions belong to institutional reporting, with defects/ceilings inherited per binding.
